notes.title: REGULAR DEMO UPDATE (AUG 2025)
notes.notes:
HELLO AGAIN, MEOWCOLYTES!

WE GOT 2 NEW LEVELS AND A BRAND NEW MAIN MENU!!!!! 😼🧙‍♂️


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102668/f012fe0f82655ac33e238071895b67425ecc5b6e.gif"]



We're starting to get into a nice groove with these updates, and we hope you're enjoying what we're putting out as much as we enjoy working on it ₍^. .^₎⟆



LEADERBOARDS HAVE BEEN RESET TOO, GO GET YOUR NAMES UP THERE!!!



Changes

Added 2 new levels to the demo (new total of 12 levels)

Improvements & changes to existing levels (based on feedback)

Overhauled the Main Menu including brand new menu music (world space UI woot woot!)

Added 3 new buttons to main menu (wishlist, discord, and feedback form)

Updated our globally used font (ooOoOoOo)

Updated the Paws (Pause) & Credits Menus

Improved rocks, slides, & floors (textures, meshes, etc.)

Improved light baking settings (aesthetics, performance)

Changed cat replay color to be blue! (from orange)

First gameplay soundtrack no longer has an extra 15-20s of silence before looping

Gameplay soundtracks now transition properly and consistently

Some UI buttons were missing hover sfx (and now they aren't)

and minor optimizations here and there :)



As always, thank you for the continued sup-pawrt... heh.

notes.title: POST TWITCH EVENT DEMO UPDATE (JUL 2025)
notes.notes:
HELLO HELLO, MEOWCOLYTES! 

For this smaller update we still have our usual 10 levels, but with slight updated visuals, and LOTS of optimization! 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102668/0274fc2996b4b7d201ce557f7e8cdea1c144ad63.gif"]

Once again thank you for being here <3 Now lets talk about some of the changes:



Changes

Due to changes in the levels, THE LEADERBOARDS GOT RESET SO GO GET YOUR BEST TIMES RIGHT MEOW!

A LOT of optimization through GPU batching! Things should be running much smoother than before. This will  mean bye bye to our glowing walls for the time being.

New meshes for our cat beds! Fresher look with a faster vibe. 

Improvements on the levels based on feedback and playtesting from our last in-person event (Twitch Vancouver Technological Exploration)

A smaller update but we are incredibly excited for more people to be able to play with our optimization efforts!  



Thank you all for your continued support! We wouldn't be here without you. ːsteamhappyː



Keep up the Meowmentum,

PurrfectPace Interactive

notes.title: POST-HIBERNATION DEMO UPDATE (JUN 2025)
notes.notes:
HELLO AGAIN, MEOWCOLYTES!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102668/2a1dbde90e02ee8e31462af7b9e1514ce9130ba1.gif"]


We're back with a hot new demo consisting of 10 levels, updated visuals, silly dancing cats, and lots of other minor improvements!!!
It certainly has been a while, and we're happy to see you here, old and new players alike! It's been an interesting few months for us, as the update from Unity 2022.3 to Unity 6 came with plenty of challenges -> but fear not, for this update will be the first of several to come this year :)


Changes

Updated Unity version (2022.3 -> 6)

Improved backend optimization (networking stuff)

Improved accuracy of replay system (the lil orange glowy cat)

Improved retention of momentum logic (more consistent)

Added 4 new levels to the demo

Re-arranged level order to better consider overall progression/NUX

Reworked level gameplay flow (restart, auto-countdown -> restart, freeze camera and start timer with player input)

Made several iterations to each level (based on playtesting/feedback)

Updated tutorialization using world-space UI (text)

Focused on getting closer to goal aesthetics with new foreground & background set dressing (e.g. cat balloons)

Added more dynamic environmental objects (e.g. meownions that dance faster based on your speed, walls that glow when you're nearby/going fast, balloons that gently move up and down)

Reworked lighting (currently 3 types: morning, afternoon, night)

Updated post-processing volumes (sky, clouds, ocean, global, etc.)

Improved lighting/mesh baking pipelines (efficiency, woo!)

Updated/replaced several old meshes and textures

Started replacing often-repeated meshes with modular kits (e.g. walls)

Updated outdated & created new SFX (UI, environment, etc.)

Added dynamic stems to every music track that only play if you're going fast enough

Updated all level select portal screenshots

Added 'Join our Discord Server' button to the menu

...and more!



Bugfixes

Fixed all build-breaking bugs (as a result of the engine update)

Fixed camera being misaligned on restart

Fixed slide-related movement bugs

Fixed a lot of minor bugs... like, a lot.



YEESH, this update was hefty. It took a while, but it feels like quite the victory for us. The engine update was a high-risk/high-reward decision, but now we're finally at a point where we get to start reaping more of the benefits. Thank you all for your continued support <3


We're stupidly excited for what's to come, so make sure you stick around ːsteamhappyː



Keep up the Meowmentum,
PurrfectPace Interactive

notes.title: PRE-HIBERNATION DEMO UPDATE (NOV 2024)
notes.notes:
Greetings Meowcolytes...

...and thank you for reading our first update announcement! This is still new to us, so we really really appreciate you being here!!! ːsteamhappyː
Let's start with a basic summary:

Changes


 Improved Menu and Settings UI


 Art (mesh) optimizations


 Reworked/optimized ghost system


 Level iterations based on player feedback


 Level 4 and 6 have swapped places for better difficulty progression


 Improved (internal) demo build pipeline


 Removed 4-digit identifier at the end of names (profile/leaderboards)


 Added a NEW music track for levels 4, 5, 6


 Added dynamic stems in the music that scales its volume with your speed



Bugfixes


 Main Menu no longer appears blank when accessed from the Paws menu in-game


 Runs are no longer saved or later uploaded to the leaderboards when playing offline


 Profile/Leaderboards no longer have mismatched usernames (rare, but happened)


 A big chunk of the changes coming ahead involves a lot of grunt work, as we are updating our Unity engine version. We've always wanted Meowmentum to be as accessible as possible, and the upgrade to Unity 6 makes using HDRP in a performant manner more viable. We wanted to make as many minor improvements as possible before this transition, so that we feel good about where we're leaving off before going full-grind mode internally.  



We're calling this a pre-hibernation demo because that's really what it is. That being said, we'll still be active on our discord server and might host some internal playtests with new features - so come chat with us on Discord!

Here's a lil' sneak peek of something we're testing:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102668/d4fd99ef2a84b638de32c3e38769409cb91c7168.gif"]
We'll see you next year!

Keep up the Meowmentum,
PurrfectPace Interactive
